COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiters (GnuCOBOL style)

purpose.summary: This batch program generates medical care information CSV data files for the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system. It reads patient, insurance, diagnosis, and medical-act records from a database and writes formatted CSV output representing clinical/receipt data. It is part of the Japanese Medical Association's open-source electronic medical record and billing system.

notable_features: Japanese comments and variable names (UTF-8 encoded)
Extensive use of COPY statements for record layouts (copybooks)
UNSTRING used to parse comma-delimited command parameters
OCCURS with INDEXED BY for table handling
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for CSV output
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — DB access via CALL to subprograms
REDEFINES used for numeric/character dual-view of fields
14 external CALL targets (subprograms for DB, utilities)
199 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Open-source JMA ORCA project license header
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 characters; the full program is 2729 lines. The file is genuine production COBOL from the Japanese open-source ORCA medical receipt system. UTF-8 encoding is confirmed and Japanese text is present in comments and data names. The COPY statement delimiter style (//) is characteristic of GnuCOBOL. No embedded SQL or CICS; database interaction is abstracted through CALL subprograms.
